artifacts.summary: Four-phase implementation plan for widening the handoff-location task-directory digit-count regex.

notes: Planning surfaced one gap absent from the research report: the new test file must also be registered in agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json's provides.scripts allowlist (verified exhaustive, 27/27 on-disk test files listed) or it will never deploy. Phase 3 covers this. Phase 4 records that the deployed .claude/ mirror keeps the broken 3-digit regex until a redeploy is run.
